prompt:
## Goal
Generate 30 NEW web site/app (desktop-first or responsive, used with mouse + keyboard) product/site topics for the scene below.

## Scene
初创公司 / SaaS 团队 × ⑤ 预约型
(L2 key: 初创公司 · 预约型)

## Existing topics already in this scene (30) — your new topics MUST differ from EVERY one
1. Demo 预约
2. Sales 洽谈
3. Waitlist 登记
4. Investor pitch call scheduling page for pre-seed founders
5. Co-founder matching speed-dating session booking site
6. Startup mentor office-hours slot reservation portal
7. Accelerator cohort interview time-slot booking platform
8. Beta user product feedback video call scheduler
9. UX research participant interview booking for SaaS teams
10. Enterprise onboarding kickoff call booking for new SaaS clients
11. Customer success quarterly business review appointment system
12. Free trial upgrade consultation call booking page
13. SaaS implementation project kickoff call scheduler
14. Advisory board one-on-one meeting booking portal
15. Growth marketing audit call booking for early-stage startups
16. B2B partnership intro call scheduling site
17. Product roadmap stakeholder review session booking portal
18. Customer discovery call scheduler for pre-product founders
19. Press and analyst briefing request booking page
20. Remote engineering interview scheduling tool for SaaS hiring
21. Software vendor procurement evaluation call booking site
22. Startup pitch competition presentation slot reservation site
23. API integration consulting call booking platform
24. Data migration assessment call scheduling system
25. Churn rescue intervention call booking portal
26. Revenue operations strategy call booking for SaaS founders
27. Enterprise contract negotiation call scheduler
28. Conference speaker application and session slot booking
29. Security compliance review call booking for SaaS vendors
30. Design sprint facilitation session booking for product teams

## Hard requirements
1. Output a JSON array of EXACTLY 30 new topic strings, in English.
2. Each topic = a concrete, buildable product/site idea, 4-12 words. Not a generic feature name.
3. CRITICAL — in-scene differentiation: every new topic must be a genuinely different
   sub-niche or use-case from EVERY existing topic listed above. Do NOT produce
   paraphrases, synonyms, renamings, or minor variations. Example: if "freelance
   invoice tracker" already exists, do NOT emit "invoice management tool for
   freelancers". If an idea overlaps in concept with any existing topic, discard it
   and find a different angle (different audience, sub-domain, mechanic, or context).
4. The 30 new topics must also be clearly distinct from each other.
5. Stay strictly within the scene — every topic must clearly belong to: 初创公司 / SaaS 团队 × ⑤ 预约型
6. Lean web-native: e.g. "open-source contributor leaderboard site", not a phone-only idea.
7. Output pure JSON — a single array of strings. No markdown fences, no commentary.

Return ONLY the JSON array of 30 strings.
